Case reference: 2020010776.CaseDesc: On July 25, 1968, Samuel Hall was seen for the last time when he went out onto Lake Ontario for a fishing trip. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Shirt: Blue, Grey, Work, Emblem with the letters "BA"

Case reference: 2014006535.CaseDesc: On the 11th of July, 1972, Edward Nemanishen was last seen by co-workers at a work site approximately 12 km North West of Spruce Home in the Alingly District of Saskatchewan. Edward was working at the site clearing farmland at 1:30 pm. A co-worker returned to the work site at 7:00 pm and Edward was gone from the site. No one has seen or heard from him since that time.

Boots: Brown, Work boot; lace up; size 8
Sweater: Dark Green, Pullover with half zipper
Deformity: Ears, white lump behind right ear; the size of a pea

Case reference: 2014005741.CaseDesc: Joseph Angus Morin had been living in Sturgeon Landing, Saskatchewan but left in December 2011, to take up residence in Wanless, MB. Joseph frequently traveled between the communities in the immediate area and was last seen in Cranberry Portage on or about January 25, 2012.

Case reference: 2020006266.CaseDesc: On February 25, 1959, Richard "Ricky" Culford was seen for the last time on Ward’s Island in Toronto, Ontario. He was last seen playing on the beach with a stick. When his mother went to retrieve him, Ricky was gone.

Hat: Brown, Gabardine helmet with a peak

Case reference: 2020010925.CaseDesc: On October 2, 1990, Mabel Wong was seen for the last time, at approximately 10:30pm, as she left her residence in Toronto, Ontario. It is believed that Mabel left her home to go meet someone. Her vehicle was found approximately two kilometers from her home.

Shoes: Leather, Black, CASUAL, with metal tips

Case reference: 2014005547.CaseDesc: Roger Alderic Leblanc was last seen on November 20, 1993, near Buckley Road, in Canaan Station, New Brunswick. Roger was walking along the train tracks with a hunting rifle. Roger's vehicle and rifle were later recovered nearby, but Roger was never seen again.

Case reference: 2018034585.CaseDesc: On September 1, 2004, at approximately 8:00 am, Stephen Lawrence was seen for the last time leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Stephen had said he would be home in a few hours.

Shirt: Blue, Brand: Calvin Klein; long sleeves

Case reference: 2014001313.CaseDesc: On August 26, 1976, at 11:00 pm, Frederick Seymour was seen for the last time as he stood outside of his residence in the Village of Kars, south of Ottawa, Ontario. Frederick had been seen by his neighbour.

Case reference: 2014003895.CaseDesc: On April 30, 1993, the RCMP were informed that Diana Thomas had fallen through the ice and not resurfaced. She was a passenger on a snowmobile with her mother and a 13-year-old driver. The trio was about 10 metres from shore on Gods River, Shamattawa, Manitoba, when the snowmobile broke through the ice. Despite attempts to recover her, these met with negative results.

Case reference: 2014006178.CaseDesc: An investigation revealed that nobody had seen or heard from Alex Klym since the mid 1970's. The family had made attempts to locate Alex, but they were unsuccessful and nobody ever reported that he was missing. Inquiries were made with various government agencies in an attempt to find some evidence of him after the mid 1970's. There is no trace of him. The body of Alex has never been recovered. It is not known what happened to Alex, but foul play cannot be ruled out.

Case reference: 2014003748.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1996, the police were contacted by a friend who reported that three of his hunting partners, including Glen Mymryk, had been missing from a hunting trip. The three men left in a loaded boat and reached halfway to their destination when they decided the water conditions were too challenging and they turned around. The men were bailing, but the waves were too much for them to handle. The motor stalled and they capsized. Glen was last seen floating away soon after the boat capsized. The sole survivor was rescued seven hours after the incident, at which point it was ascertained that the other two men had drowned.

Case reference: 2012020005.CaseDesc: David Cox was last seen on April 8, 2011 in the Cranbrook, BC area.  He was known to be living a high risk lifestyle. His disappearance is considered suspicious in nature and foul play has not been ruled out.

Case reference: 2018053566.CaseDesc: On September 26, 1995, at approximately 8:30am, Robert Walmsley was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Robert was scheduled to meet with his sister the following day, but did not show up.

Case reference: 2016052152.CaseDesc: On September 13, 2016 at approximately 9:30 p.m., John Casey was seen for the last time aboard a cruise vessel in transit between Cap-aux-Meules and Havre Saint-Pierre, Quebec. John has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2019000913.CaseDesc: On January 1, 2019, Daniel Hill was seen for the last time in Medicine Hat, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014002315.CaseDesc: In 1983, Dennis Chubb relocated from God's Lake Narrows to Winnipeg, Manitoba. It is understood that he was residing in a boarding house on Furby Street in the city centre of Winnipeg. Dennis was last seen entering this residential building after being driven there by a family member. It has been reported that Dennis relocated from this lodging establishment to another property immediately prior to his disappearance. We are currently unaware of his whereabouts.

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Jewelry: Wood, rope around the neck with wooden cross
Socks: White, Grey, white top and grey on bottom
Tattoo: Right Shoulder, sword and a cross
Left Hand, Text "Ozzy", one letter on each finger

Case reference: 2014004908.CaseDesc: David Buckmire was last seen leaving his home in Toronto, Ontario, at approximately 12:00 p.m. on July 31, 2003.

Case reference: 2014004116.CaseDesc: Diane Tresham was last seen on March 27, 2000, leaving her residence in Welland, Ontario.  Her vehicle was later located along the Niagara River Parkway.  At that time, Diane was said to be feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2008008099.CaseDesc: Ronald Wallin was canoeing in the Upper Manitou Lake located south of Dryden, Ontario.  Ronald suffered from what appeared to be a seizure and fell into the water disappearing beneath the boat. The area was searched, but he wasn't found.

Case reference: 2023031245.CaseDesc: Cody Higbee was last seen in the city of Calgary, Alberta on the June 14, 2023.  Cody is known to spend time in the areas near the CF Chinook Shopping Centre and in the Bridlewood neighbourhood near the Calgary Transit (C-Train) lines. Cody suffers from a medical condition which can lead to confusion or disorientation.

Case reference: 2020009327.CaseDesc: On April 1, 2020, James Garnett was seen for the last time at approximately 9:25 P.M. when he was exiting a bus onto Douglas Avenue near the Reversing Falls Bridge located in Saint John, New Brunswick.

Hat: Blue, White, Toque, Has white snowflakes

Case reference: 2012020078.CaseDesc: Anthony Whitehead was last seen on June 2, 1990, at a party on the Gordon First Nation in Saskatchewan. Despite searches and investigations over the years, Anthony has not been located.

Tattoo: Skull with top hat on one arm, unknown which arm
Middle Back, Skull and dragon, others
Left Hand, Phyllis Bluecloud covered to look like a bear

Case reference: 2014002717.CaseDesc: Giuseppe Colina was last seen on March 15, 1979, in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, Giuseppe left his residence early to go to work. He told his co-workers he was leaving early because he had things to do and did not complete his work day.

Case reference: 2017074201.CaseDesc: On August 23, 1995, the remains of an unidentified man were discovered in Lake Ontario, near Cherry Beach, in Toronto, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he may be of European ancestry.

Case reference: 2013000048.CaseDesc: On May 26, 2002, Mendes Joseph was seen for the last time at his apartment located in the Montréal-Nord district of Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2006007899.CaseDesc: Edward Michael Krantz was last seen on August 23, 1975. He paddled alone into Lake Huron to go fishing, in a 17 foot aluminium MICHI Craft canoe, serial MCC11799M74JF7. Edward and the canoe have never been located.

Pants: Orange, Red, white and blue striped pants
Socks: White, Knee high, yellow top stripe
Scar: Lower Back, 25 inch vertical scar from surgery

Case reference: 2008006699.CaseDesc: On June 18, 1967, Stanley Sczcygiel was fishing on the Berens River with two other Americans.  All three were swept over the falls.  The other two men survived, however Stanley is presumed to have drowned.  His body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2014003322.CaseDesc: Anne Matthews was last seen on December 8, 1983, at the Homewood Health Centre, in Ontario.  An extensive search was conducted of the area and the river where footprints were located.

Coat: Red, Black, Felt coat with black embroidery bottom and a fox fur hood

Case reference: 2013000007.CaseDesc: Kimberly Ann McAndrew has been missing since August 12, 1989 from Halifax, Nova Scotia. At 4:20 P.M. that day, she left the Canadian Tire on 6203 Quinpool Road where she was employed as a cashier. There were unconfirmed reports that Kimberly was last seen at the Gardenia Flower Shop in Penhorn Mall in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia. Kimberly was identified by an employee at the flower shop as having bought a balloon and a rose.

Shoes: Jade green, flat heeled slip on loafers

Case reference: 2006023099.CaseDesc: Gordon Zeigler was last seen on January 3, 1991, heading to a camp on Elizabeth Lake, Ontario by snowmobile. Although his snowmobile was located on Lake Nipigon, he was never found and is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2021042160.CaseDesc: On September 16, 2021, at approximately 7:00 a.m., Darren Werner was last seen at his residence in the town Niagara-on-the-Lake in Ontario. It is possible that Darren had gotten into an unknown vehicle.

Case reference: 2013000087.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1993, Allan Curtis was seen for the last time during a visit to his uncle’s home in Montreal, Quebec. Allan was to take a flight from Mirabel airport to go home to British Columbia, however he never arrived at his destination.

Case reference: 2014001381.CaseDesc: On March 24, 1982, Patricia Elizabeth Flynn was last seen running away from her family residence in a densely wooded area near her home in Yarrow, British-Colombia. Patricia was despondent and had medical issues that required attention at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004872.CaseDesc: Andre Lemieux was last seen on January 9, 2007 in Montreal, Quebec. Andre brought his child to daycare that day and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2015052895.CaseDesc: Ujjvalkumar Patel was last seen on June 15, 2015 at his workplace in Brampton, ON. Ujjvalkumar was attending college in Ontario. He told his landlord he was returning to India for a family emergency but never showed up.

Case reference: 2014004457.CaseDesc: Stephon Payne was last seen at his residence on October 6, 2002. On the same day, Stephon was seen in the area of 106 Avenue and 84 Street, Edmonton, Alberta. Stephon may have also been in the area of the Dawson Bridge in Edmonton. A jacket believed to be Stephon’s was found at the bridge.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Heart with dagger

Case reference: 2014002404.CaseDesc: On June 11, 1988, Andrew Flett was walking with others to the cutline. He did not arrive at the site, and it was assumed that he had returned to camp. He was reported missing three days later to the RCMP, and an extensive search was conducted. Andrew has not been located, and his whereabouts are currently unknown.

Shirt: Red, Black, Plaid and button up

Case reference: 2018016267.CaseDesc: Yvette Bourgon was seen for the last time on approximately March 1, 1966 in Montreal, Quebec.  Yvette was hospitalized at Louis-H Lafontaine, formerly known as St-Jean-de-Dieu. Yvette's footprints were found in the snow near the Lachine Canal in Verdun, Quebec. Her purse was found without her wallet in close proximity to the footprints.

Case reference: 2014004498.CaseDesc: Guillermina Coleman left her residence at the Cypress View Foundation retirement home in Medicine Hat, Alberta between 8 p.m. on July 4 and 10 a.m. on  July 5, 2004. Only a few days before she was last seen, she had been discharged from hospital in a despondent state. Guillermina could only walk short distances.

Case reference: 2014001088.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1973, the remains of an adult male were recovered from the Whirlpool of the Niagara River, in Niagara Falls. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 165lbs, however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His eye colour is believed to be brown. He was recovered without clothing.

Ring: Silver ring with a green stone on the third finger of his right hand
Watch: Cloth, Left wrist, had a red, yellow and blue watchstrap.

Case reference: 2021014303.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2013, at approximately 3:56 p.m., Peter Lipinoga was last seen in the area of Terrapin Point in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of his disappearance, Peter was despondent.

Case reference: 2023061459.CaseDesc: Darwin Johnsgaard was seen for the last time on October 18, 2023, at the Dollarama in Strathmore, Alberta.  Darwin is known for using resources for the homeless, including the Mustard Seed Shelter in Calgary, Alberta.

Hat: Black, Baseball cap with "Gas Monkey Garage" logo
Scar: Scar on right side of head

Case reference: 2014003393.CaseDesc: The last confirmed contact between James Siwy and his family was in 1982 in the Drumheller, Alberta area.  Shortly thereafter, he relocated to Ontario with some acquaintances.  They were travelling in a 1975 white four-door Dodge Monaco with a burgundy roof.  In 1984, the Monaco was discovered in Ontario. There were unconfirmed reports that he may have been hitchhiking in the Northern Ontario region.  In 1994, James' family reported him missing after attempting to notify him about the death of a family member.

Hair: Brown, Wavy, Long, Parted in the middle

Case reference: 2014003060.CaseDesc: Pierre Lagacé was last seen on January 5, 2003, where he was living in the LeMoyne sector of Longueuil, Québec. Pierre was reported missing by a family member and at the time of his disappearance, he had little money and no car in his name.

Case reference: 2012020002.CaseDesc: Perry Sebastian was last seen December 26, 2011. Perry is from the Hagwilget First Nations reserve and reported missing from the Southbank area of Burns Lake, British Columbia. He was reportedly despondent.

Case reference: 2018040962.CaseDesc: Ryan Duncan was last seen on July 17, 2018, at a motel in Lumby, British Columbia, while travelling in the area. Ryan's vehicle was located in Vernon, British Columbia on July 21, 2018.

Case reference: 2016069147.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1974, the body of a Caucasian male was found on the CNR tracks, 200 yards west of the CNR Station, Hearst, Ontario. A witness observed the remains on the tracks after an advancing train had passed. His post-mortem length was recorded as being 5’8” however; this measurement may not represent his actual living height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He was described as having a medium build. He may have been wearing glasses according to police reports.

Teeth: Good, Missing upper left 3rd molar. Several of his upper and lower posterior teeth had amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.

Teeth: Visible Decay, Missing an upper front tooth on the left side prior to death. The upper front tooth on the right side was angled.
Deformity: Left Knee, Osgoode-Schlatter's disease - bony bump on shin below knee

Case reference: 2021022793.CaseDesc: On May 30, 2021, Thomas Grise was last seen at a family residence in Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014006038.CaseDesc: Kimberley Cruickshank was reported missing on March 25, 2013. She was last seen on March 22, 2013 in her apartment on the 2400 Block of Abbott Road in Regina, SK.

Hair: Brown, Red, Straight, Hair is shaved around sides and back with medium length section on the top
Pierce: Ears, 3 piercings on the right side and 1 on the left

Case reference: 2013000140.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1981, Rene Laflamme was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. René had visited his mother in Ottawa, Ontario and had left her residence to travel back to Montreal.

Hair: Black, Straight, recently permed black hair

Case reference: 2012020147.CaseDesc: On March 25, 1996, the skeletal remains of a man were found near the Upper Levels Highway in West Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had recovered from severe injuries to his right arm and leg. He also had a fractured skull, nose and ribs. These injuries were likely a result of a single major accident. It is estimated that he may have died several months prior to the discovery of his remains.

Jacket: Corduroy, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 3/4 length coat with fleece
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Side Of Head, Recent fracture to the left temporal bone above the left ear
Nose, Old nasal fracture with visible deformity
Deformity: Shoulders, Old injury; no indication of which shoulder

Case reference: 2014005403.CaseDesc: John Saulitis left his residence in Hamilton, Ontario in June 2006, and never returned. He spends a significant amount of time outdoors and has been known to be away from his residence for extended periods of time. In 2010, John was reported missing by his brother.

Case reference: 2012020072.CaseDesc: Claudette Osborne (born Tyo) was last seen leaving the Lincoln Motor Hotel on McPhillips Street in Winnipeg, Manitoba on the morning of 25 July 2008.

Hair: Brown, Blonde, Straight, Long, Bottom 12" dyed blonde

Case reference: 2014001590.CaseDesc: On May 1, 1990, Claude L'Heureux was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Claude had worked in bars in The Village district of Montreal, Quebec. No one has seen or heard from him since.

Case reference: 2019053661.CaseDesc:
On July 2, 1988, an unidentified man was found in the parking lot of the Value Village
on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had suffered from a
heart attack, and the results of his autopsy showed evidence of previous heart damage and a case of mild chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Case reference: 2012749001.CaseDesc: Lonnie Boudreau was last seen in the city of Ottawa, Ontario in February 1981. He has not been heard from since.

Hair: Blonde, Short, Straight, parted from left to right
Teeth: Good, Small gap between the two front teeth
Mark: Left Side Of Neck, Beauty mark

Case reference: 2014006541.CaseDesc: Roxanne Fleming was last seen in the Michaels Park neighbourhood of Edmonton, Alberta, on December 27, 1986.  Following the last contact, she has been based in Lillooet, Kamloops, Vancouver (British Columbia), Red Deer (Alberta).  We are unaware of the circumstances of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.

Case reference: 2014005439.CaseDesc: John Sparrow was last seen in April or May of 2001, getting into an early 1990s black Chevrolet pick-up truck while accompanied by an unknown male driver. John and the unknown man left the parking lot of the Denny's restaurant located at Benson Ave and Division St, in the city of Kingston, Ontario and headed north past highway #401.

Case reference: 2006013999.CaseDesc: Walter Glynn was last seen on July 23, 1980 walking southbound on Main Street, Kirkland Lake.  He was heading to the A&P grocery store at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014006145.CaseDesc: On June 9, 2013, police discovered Raymond Salmen's truck and camper abandoned at a campsite located approximately 50 kilometres up the West Harrison Forest Service Road at Harrison Mills, British Columbia.   A large-scale search operation was conducted on land and water, but Raymond was not located. Raymond has considerable expertise in wilderness survival, and has not been seen or heard from  since.

Case reference: 2023001420.CaseDesc: On November 7, 2022, Sohail Shahid was seen for the last time at Terrapin Point, American Falls, Niagara Falls, New York. Witnesses observed Sohail jumping over the railing. At the time of his disappearance, Sohail was despondent.

Case reference: 2017021464.CaseDesc: Since April 14, 2017, Deborah Ann Hutchinson's family has not seen or heard from her. Deborah's vehicle, a 2005 white Kia Magentis, was later located in the Cossitt Heights area of Sydney, Nova Scotia.

Case reference: 2014004372.CaseDesc: Patrick-Jean De Loppinot was last seen on September 11, 2003, at a friend's residence in Laval, Quebec. Patrick-Jean was supposed to go home that evening but never arrived. He was driving a black 1990 Volkswagen Jetta registered in Québec. At the time of his disappearance, Patrick-Jean lived with family in Longueuil, Quebec.

Case reference: 2024011368.CaseDesc: Guildo Maurice was last seen on March 8, 2024 in the village of St-Augustin, Quebec. The investigation shows that he left with his snowmobile. It was found under the ice between St-Augustin and Rivière-St-Paul, Quebec.

Case reference: 2011005399.CaseDesc: Carol Shelleau was last seen on July 29 1988, by her children, as she was leaving her home in Sault Ste Marie, Ontario. Carol got on the back of her estranged husband's motorcycle and has not been seen since. Her estranged husband was found deceased in Vancouver in September 1988. The motorcycle involved was located in Sault Ste. Marie. Foul play is suspected.

Backpack: Green, Duffle bag containing a bathing suit
Glasses: Large and round with tinted lenses
Pants: White, With blue, pink and red stripes

Case reference: 2014005577.CaseDesc: Ganiyu Adedeji Onabule was reported missing in Edmonton in June of 1975. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2013000053.CaseDesc: On October 20 2010, OPP were called to the Iroquois Locks, Iroquois ON by the Captain of a Bulk Laker reporting that crew member Gary Charlton had not shown up for his noon shift.  Crew members and the OPP conducted searches of the vessel without locating Charlton.  He was last seen on the vessel by crew members at 4:10 a.m., October 20, 2010 when the vessel was in Lake Ontario in the Cobourg area.

Case reference: 2020021899.CaseDesc: Nowell Halfe was last seen by his family in Edmonton, Alberta, in 2013. The last documented sighting of Nowell was in Edmonton in January 2014.

Case reference: 2014002824.CaseDesc: On July 20, 1985, Sidney Manning was reported missing by his family in Chilliwack, British Columbia. On July 17, 1985, Sydney departed from Cultus Lake, B.C. in his brown 1984 Oldsmobile. On August 4, 1985, his vehicle was located abandoned on a forest service road in Hope, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2023039179.CaseDesc: Denis Taylor was last seen on July 22, 2023 at the Bulpit Lake Family Camp, located on Stringer Road in Carlow Mayo Township, East of Bancroft, Ontario. Denis planned to meet everyone in the common beach area after a brief nap in his cabin, which was located a distance away, but he never arrived. Denis may have woken up disoriented in the new cabin and taken the wrong path to the communal area.

Shirt: Blue, White, Long sleeve checkered shirt

Case reference: 2016018567.CaseDesc: Mekayla was last seen at the STC Bus Depot in Yorkton at 1:45 p.m. on April 12, 2016. She went to school in the morning, but left shortly after arriving. She went to several businesses in Yorkton throughout the morning, then returned to school around noon. She bought lunch at the restaurant in the bus depot, but did not get on a bus that day. Mekayla left the bus depot in the early afternoon and hasn't been seen since.

Case reference: 2025001081.CaseDesc: Thomas Hatcher was reported missing on January 7, 2025 from Durante's Trailer Park in Sioux Lookout, Ontario. The last record of him is from CCTV footage, in which he was observed walking eastwards in the direction of a wooded area on the morning of the 7th. Extensive searches were conducted, and his abandoned backpack was found to contain his birth certificate and other personal belongings. At that time, Thomas was feeling despondent.

Hat: Grey, Red, Grey toque with a red stripe

Case reference: 2014004899.CaseDesc: Claude Barbier was last seen on November 16, 1996, with his girlfriend at the Cooke residence in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. On November 18, 1996, the body of his girlfriend was pulled from the St-Lawrence River near St-Antoine-de-Tilly, Quebec. Claude has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2006006499.CaseDesc: On July 24, 1972, Clifford Boyle was aboard the S.S. Gleneagle on which he was employed. He was last seen on the deck of the left side of the ship near the back.  It is presumed that Clifford fell overboard and is presumed drowned in Georgian Bay, Ontario.

Amputation: Right Index Finger, End of finger missing

Case reference: 2015011654.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1994, a baby was found in the Rivière des Prairies between the island of Montréal and the Visitation park Island in the Ahuntsic neighborhood. The body was naked and had a plastic bag wrapped around the wrist. According to experts the body would have been in the water since the fall.

Case reference: 2025012234.CaseDesc: Shanda Playford was last seen at approximately 3:00pm on February 25, 2025, on Melvin Avenue within the City of Greater Sudbury. Police investigations into Shanda's disappearance are still active and there is no evidence to rule out foul play.

Case reference: 2009004299.CaseDesc: On March 12, 1973, Madeleine Van Overdijk was reported missing by her husband.  She was last seen at her residence in Brantford, Ontario. Information reported to police suggested she was going to Toronto. It is unknown if in fact she made it to Toronto.

Case reference: 2013000021.CaseDesc: Bones of a right foot with its sock and shoe were found along the bank of the Ottawa river in Gatineau, Quebec.

Case reference: 2006012999.CaseDesc: Joshua Kennett was last seen in the water following the capsizing of the vessel he was travelling in on Grayson Lake, Ontario, on 13 October 1995. It is presumed that Joshua drowned.

Case reference: 2014003608.CaseDesc: Brianne Wolgram was last seen on the evening of September 5, 1998, in Revelstoke, British Columbia.  Ms. Wolgram had plans to socialize with friends that evening but did not attend.  Ms. Wolgram's vehicle was located on September 10, 1998 on the Alkolkolex Forest Service Road near Revelstoke.

Case reference: 2014003825.CaseDesc: Ruby Ann Hardy was reported missing by her brother in 2002. She was last seen in the downtown east side of Vancouver in June 1997, and was engaged in a high risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2024011240.CaseDesc: Melanie Lapish was last seen on February 26, 2024, in the town of Fort Frances, Ontario. Melanie has ties to the Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario area.

Tattoo: Lower Back, Tribal tattoo with butterfly, black and white, 102 mm (4 inches)

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2017045266.CaseDesc: On August 7, 2017, James Candy was reported missing from his residence north of Lavoy, Alberta. James was last seen in his bedroom the night before on August 6, 2017 at approximately 11:00 pm.

Case reference: 2014005222.CaseDesc: On May 12, 2008, at approximately noon, Syed Zaman was seen for the last time at his home in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004248.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1979, at approximately 5:00 a.m., Myrna Montgrand was seen for the last time outside of a residence in La Loche, Saskatchewan. Earlier that morning, Myrna had been with a group of people at a party.

Case reference: 2013000115.CaseDesc: Gaby Luonga Kombe was last seen on August 23, 1999, in Montreal, Quebec. Gaby had to go to Pie-IX metro station to meet a friend. Later in the evening, he called his son to tell him he was heading home. Gaby has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2019043680.CaseDesc: On July 29, 2019, Rachid Jalifi left his apartment in West Vancouver, British Columbia and was confirmed to have boarded a flight to Mexico. Rachid was last heard from on July 31, 2019 and has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003132.CaseDesc: On December 29, 1978, Sharon Drover was seen for the last time in downtown St. John's, Newfoundland & Labrador. Sharon left her boarding house located on Livingstone Street and arrived for her evening shift at the McDonald’s restaurant located on Kenmount Road where she finished her shift after midnight.  Investigators believe Sharon intended to hitchhike home after her shift.

Case reference: 2012020114.CaseDesc: Sebastien Metivier went missing in Montreal, Quebec on November 1, 1984. The young boy was in front of the Tres-Saint-Nom-de-Jesus church on the east side of the city and he was heading to an arts and crafts course.

Pants: Blue, Patch on the right knee

Case reference: 2014005974.CaseDesc: Éric Descoteaux's relatives have had no news of him since January 2009, when he left the town in which he resided, Harrington, in the Laurentians, Quebec. Éric left without warning, and stopped contacting his relatives.

Case reference: 2014001578.CaseDesc: Benjamin Arsenault went missing from 172 Sydney Street, in Saint John, New Brunswick (Rooming House). Benjamin was wearing a grey suit coat.

Case reference: 2014003446.CaseDesc: Dawn Crey was a resident of the downtown east side of Vancouver; she was engaged in a high risk lifestyle. She was reported missing on December 11, 2000 after failing to attend a medical appointment. Foul play is suspected in Ms. Crey's disappearance.

Case reference: 2013000139.CaseDesc: The Calgary Police Service is seeking the public's assistance in locating Clayton Condos. He was last seen on March 20, 2006, in Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014001102.CaseDesc: On March 4, 1973, the remains of a young adult man were recovered from the Burrard Inlet in Vancouver, British Columbia. He carried a Canada flag pocket knife and is believed to have been in the water for several months prior to the discovery.

Case reference: 2014003781.CaseDesc: William Leslie has not been seen or heard from by anyone, including his family, since September, 1993. His belongings were found in a remote area. He had been staying in a tent in the bush Southeast of Beaverlodge in Alberta. It appeared the tent was pitched in the fall of 1993. William's belongings were located under 2-3 feet of snow, along with his truck and bicycle. A jean jacket and leather jacket were located in the truck.

Hair: Brown, Shoulder, Short on top and long in back
Tattoo: Left Arm, Text "live your own life" in a ribbon
Right Arm, Text "born to be bad" and "Mom Dad"

Case reference: 2013000114.CaseDesc: Abigail Andrews, a single Metis woman, lived in a basement suite in Fort St. John. She worked at FSJ Fashions, and The Frontier Bar and Grill. She was pregnant but not yet showing. Abigail was last seen on the evening of April 7, 2010 walking from her home towards a friend's house.

Teeth: Good, Used a dental pallet retainer
Deformity: Right Index Finger, Previously broken and healed in a deformed position
